tagline: Intelligent CCTV Surveillance for Housing Societies & Premises

auth.signin_helper: We'll email you a 6-digit code. No password needed.
auth.code_sent: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It works for 10 minutes.
auth.resend_wait: Send a new code in {n} s
auth.phone_helper: Enter your mobile number. We'll send a 6-digit verification code to it.
auth.phone_code_helper: We sent a 6-digit code to {phone}. It works for 5 minutes.
auth.telegram_helper: Alerts arrive in Telegram. Connect the account that uses {phone}.
auth.step_share_num: Tap Start, then tap Share my number
auth.step_return: Come back here. This page updates by itself.
auth.test_delivered: Test alert delivered in {n} s. Check Telegram.
auth.retention_rule: VYZN keeps footage and clips for 72 hours, then deletes them.
auth.error_invalid_email: Enter a valid email address, like name@shop.in.
auth.error_wrong_code: That code isn't right. Check the newest email, or send a new code.
auth.error_code_expired: That code has expired. Send a new code.
auth.error_too_many_tries: Too many tries. Wait 15 minutes, then send a new code.
auth.error_invalid_phone: Enter a 10-digit mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
auth.error_number_mismatch: The number shared in Telegram doesn't match {phone}. Share the number of this Telegram account, or change your mobile number.
auth.error_link_expired: This link has expired. Get a new link.
auth.error_tg_unreachable: We couldn't reach Telegram. Try again in a minute.

overview.flags_checked_moments: VYZN checked {count} moments in the last 24 hours and saved {saved} clips.
overview.expiry_warning: {count} flags will be deleted in the next 12 hours. Download an evidence pack to keep a copy.
overview.watching_whole_view: Watching the whole view. Draw an area to ignore everything else.
overview.add_first_camera_sub: Connect a CCTV camera, a recorder, or a spare phone.

clips.title: Important clips
clips.empty: No clips yet. VYZN saves a clip when something happens inside a watch area.
clips.deleted_clip: This clip was deleted after 72 hours.
clips.toast_not_issue: Marked as not an issue. Undo
clips.reason_staff: It was me or my staff

areas.watching_whole_view: Watching the whole view. Draw an area to ignore everything else.
areas.applies_notice: Changes apply to new footage from the moment of saving. Clips already saved are not changed.
areas.saved_toast: Areas saved. Applies to new footage.
areas.ignored_moments_count: Since you set this area, {count} moments outside it were ignored.
areas.empty_offline_picture: Picture from {time}. The camera is offline.
areas.empty_no_picture: Connect the camera to draw its areas.
areas.unsaved_warning: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?

cameras.type_ip_desc: CCTV camera, DVR or NVR. You know its IP address.
cameras.type_network_desc: VYZN looks for cameras and recorders on your local society/premises network (the local server). Works when this computer is on the same Wi-Fi or network as the cameras.
cameras.type_phone_desc: Use a spare phone, or this computer's webcam, as a camera.
cameras.advanced_toggle: Advanced: paste a full stream address
cameras.network_scanning: Looking for cameras on your network…
cameras.network_empty: No cameras found. Check that this computer is on the same network as your cameras, or add one by IP address.
cameras.phone_step1: 1. Install the free IP Webcam app on Android or DroidCam on iOS or Android
cameras.phone_step2: 2. Connect the phone to the shop Wi-Fi and tap Start server
cameras.phone_step3: 3. Paste the address shown on the phone
cameras.webcam_helper: Good for trying VYZN. Use a CCTV camera for the shop.
cameras.err_auth_failed: The camera rejected the username or password. Check them and try again.
cameras.err_timeout: Couldn't reach {ip}. Check that the camera is on and on the same network as this computer.
cameras.err_port_closed: The camera didn't answer on port {port}. Check the port, or try 8554.
cameras.err_not_found: The camera answered, but not for this channel. Try a different channel or brand.
cameras.err_unsupported_codec: The camera's video format isn't supported. In the camera settings, switch the stream to H.264.
cameras.choose_area_next: Now choose the part of the picture VYZN should watch.
cameras.choose_area_hint: Choose the area to watch to get fewer false flags
cameras.remove_confirm_body: Its saved footage and clips will be deleted now.
cameras.troubleshoot_1: Check that the camera power adapter is plugged in and switched on.
cameras.troubleshoot_2: Verify that the network cable or Wi-Fi is connected.
cameras.troubleshoot_3: Check if your router or switch restarted recently.
cameras.troubleshoot_4: Try opening the camera's web address in a browser to check if it responds.

settings.retention_statement: VYZN keeps footage and clips for 72 hours, then deletes them. This can't be changed.

common.generic_error: Something went wrong. Try again. If it keeps happening, check Settings → System health.
common.offline_notice: You're offline. Showing what was last loaded.
